content.short: PACT provides cutting-edge infrastructure for private credit rwas, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Pact is a fully decentralized automated market maker (AMM) built on the Algorand blockchain, offering deep liquidity and low transaction fees. As a prominent player in the Real World Asset Dapps space, PACT specializes in delivering high-quality private credit rwas infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Celo and Polygon, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, PACT focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
